attempts.summary: Created a locked-password opsbot account on both node1 and node2 (RHEL 7). Generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1 and installed the public key in opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, enabling passwordless SSH from node1's opsbot to node2's opsbot. Enforced key-only auth for opsbot specifically (not system-wide) via a `Match User opsbot` block in sshd_config on both nodes (PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey), verified with `sshd -T` and by confirming a password-only SSH attempt was rejected with "Permission denied (publickey)". Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id/uptime baselines on both nodes, restarted node1 then node2 sequentially (never concurrently), confirmed each came back with a new boot_id, and re-verified sshd active, opsbot account intact, publickey-only policy still enforced, authorized_keys present, and live cross-node key-based SSH functioning after both restarts.
